svg.aria-label: the cold dark matter distribution forming the cosmic web
svg.title: Cosmic web, Zel'dovich realisation of Planck 2018 LCDM
svg.desc: Cold dark matter, Zel'dovich approximation. Planck 2018 LCDM (Omega_m 0.315, Omega_L 0.685, h 0.674, n_s 0.965, sigma_8 0.811), Eisenstein-Hu 1998 transfer function, Gaussian initial conditions smoothed at 2.5 Mpc/h. A 150x40 Mpc/h comoving slice; each curve is a line of matter elements. Time runs from 0.15 to 40 Gyr after the big bang; the displacement scales with the LCDM linear growth factor, which saturates as dark energy takes over.
